items_all.title: Intel's next-gen Nova Lake chips may skip game-boosting X3D cache rival for mobile SKUs and debut on Razor Lake-HX instead, leaker claims — new rumor says Razor Lake family reportedly uses TSMC's N2X node
items_all.summary: Nova Lake desktop CPUs look to be the exclusive recipient of bLLC, Intel's answer to AMD's X3D, as the company looks to debut bLLC on mobile with Razor Lake-HX, and possibly Razor Lake-AX. As such, the Razor Lake family is also rumored to be manufactured on TSCM's N2X process node.

items_all.summary_zh: Nova Lake 桌面 CPU 有望成为 bLLC 的独家接收者，bLLC 是英特尔对 AMD X3D 的回应，因为该公司希望通过 Razor Lake-HX 以及可能的 Razor Lake-AX 在移动设备上首次推出 bLLC。因此，据传 Razor Lake 系列也将在 TSCM 的 N2X 工艺节点上制造。
